text.content:
Movement in combat (SR2 p.84). Movement never costs you actions — it does not change what Free, Simple or Complex Actions are available. Rates are per Combat Phase. You may also simply stand still.

Walking

Move up to your Quickness in metres this Combat Phase.

  • +1 target number if you combine the move with an action requiring a Success Test.
  • +2 if the movement is over rough terrain or through obstacles.

Running

Move Quickness × the Running Modifier for your metatype, in metres per Combat Phase.

MetatypeRunning Modifier
Human×3
Elf×3
Ork×3
Dwarf×2
Troll×2
  • +4 target number to any test attempted while running.
  • A character with Running Skill may spend a Complex Action (Use Skill) to push further: each success against Target Number 4 adds 1 point of effective Quickness for that Combat Phase.

Once per Combat Turn

A character with several Combat Phases in a Turn may run in only one of them — though it does not matter which. Their other phases are walking at most.

Interception

Moving within one metre of an opponent lets that opponent intercept — see the full rule on p.84.

The system can enforce these rates for you: enable Settings → Limit movement in combat and the drag ruler turns green within a walk, amber into a run, and refuses a drop past the running maximum.
